# Arizona House of Film
> Window tinting company serving Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa and all of Arizona since 2012. Licensed ROC #314088.

## Services
- [Residential Window Tinting](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/residential-window-tinting): Ceramic films for homes that block 84% solar heat
- [Commercial Window Tinting](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/commercial-window-tinting): Industrial solar control for office buildings and retail
- [Decorative & Privacy Films](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/decorative-window-films): Frosted, patterned and custom decorative films
- [Safety & Security Film](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/safety): 8-12 mil impact-resistant films
- [Anti-Graffiti Film](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/anti-graffiti-window-film): Sacrificial protective films for storefronts
- [Energy Saving Films](https://arizonahouseoffilm.com/energy-saving-window-films): SRP/APS rebate-ready solar control

## Service Areas
Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Queen Creek, Tucson, Flagstaff and 100+ Arizona cities
